The Latest Report

The room was the prize. Xi Jinping hosted the first meeting of an American president with the leaders of Russia and China together, in the city China built to prove its model. The text the three men signed fits on an index card.

Latest Report · Thursday, November 19, 2026

Four Points, No Dates

Three presidents signed a four-point declaration in Shenzhen that names no war, sets no date and caps nothing. The decisions that bind carry dates of their own: a European summit on November 26, the Federal Reserve on December 9, and the Texas grid audit on December 10.

The Shenzhen declaration is four points of agreement among three governments that agree on almost nothing else, and its only clause with a specific target is the one shielding sitting officials from the International Criminal Court. That clause pays one man in the room.

What moved this week moved elsewhere, on dates that are already fixed. The board is not being set in summit rooms this month. It is being set by calendars.

Four Points, No Dates · Morning Report

Four numbers, one argument

The declaration committed nobody. These are the numbers attached to the decisions that bind.

-27.29 sq kmRussia’s net ground change in October
Russian forces seized 139.85 square kilometres and lost 167.14 in October 2026, by the Institute for the Study of War’s count, in the month they were supposed to be grinding forward.
€45BEurope’s proposed 2027 loan for Ukraine
Proposed on November 18 against an estimated €70 billion gap for 2027. It needs approval from all 27 member states, and Ukraine repays the principal only if Russia pays reparations.
90-96%Market odds of a quarter-point Fed hike
Across futures and prediction markets on November 18 and 19, the chance of a 25 basis point increase on December 9 sat between roughly 90 and 96 percent, with most of the remainder on a half point.
6,608 MWTexas load cleared to the final gate
Seventeen large loads have cleared every ERCOT gate except permission to switch on, against about 474 gigawatts of connection requests in the queue. The last number is the load that is real this winter.

THE BOARDPURPOSE

Why The Board exists.

I don’t have a ton of time. It’s hard to keep up.

There are so many conflicting narratives, fed by conflicting interests. It feels hard to know what is true, and I know I’m not alone in that.

I often have questions I want answered, or things I don’t understand, that the news simply doesn’t cover. Not all of the time, but sometimes. When that happens, there is nowhere obvious to go for a straight answer.

In my ideal world, I build something useful to me. Something I enjoy reading. Because if I do, so will other people, and it will help them too.

The Board is a personal project. Everything here reflects my own views and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representative of my employer.
